meta.name: text-to-speech
meta.description: Convert text to natural speech with Inworld TTS, ElevenLabs, DIA TTS, Kokoro, Chatterbox, and more via inference.sh CLI. Models: Inworld TTS-2 (100+ languages, emotion steering), Inworld TTS 1.5 (ultra-low latency), ElevenLabs (premium, 22+ voices, 32 languages), DIA TTS (conversational), Kokoro TTS, Chatterbox, Higgs Audio, VibeVoice (podcasts). Capabilities: text-to-speech, voice cloning, multi-speaker dialogue, podcast generation, expressive speech, emotion/delivery steering, character voices. Use for: voiceovers, audiobooks, podcasts, accessibility, video narration, IVR, voice assistants, gaming characters, avatar audio. Triggers: text to speech, tts, voice generation, ai voice, speech synthesis, voice over, generate speech, ai narrator, voice cloning, text to audio, elevenlabs, eleven labs, voice ai, ai voiceover, speech generator, natural voice, inworld, inworld tts, character voice, game voice, npc voice

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将文字转为自然语音，支持多种AI语音引擎
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将文本转为高质量语音用于视频、播客或有声内容
copy.tagline_en: Convert text to natural speech with multiple AI voice engines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn text into high-quality speech for videos, podcasts, or audio content

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以将你提供的文字转换成自然语音，支持多种语音模型，包括情感控制、多说话人对话、播客生成等功能。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 生成语音、朗读文字、制作配音或播客时触发。

say.text: 请用 Inworld TTS-2 把这句话转成语音，语气要兴奋。
say.note: 生成带情感控制的语音。

say.text: 用 ElevenLabs 朗读这段文字，选 Sarah 的声音。
帮我生成一个播客脚本的语音，用 VibeVoice。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can convert your text into natural speech using multiple models, supporting emotion control, multi-speaker dialogue, podcast generation, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to generate speech, read text aloud, create voiceovers, or produce podcasts.

say_en.text: Use Inworld TTS-2 to convert this text to speech with an excited tone.
Read this text aloud using ElevenLabs with Sarah's voice.
Generate a podcast voiceover for this script using VibeVoice.
